notes: Eight of ten screens are complete and consistent with the shell and finance/receipt patterns. The two creation forms, REM-004 and FIN-006, have collapsed field grids that make their inputs unreadable and require rework before sign-off.

screens.summary: Personal reminders list is complete and legible, with clear tabs, table, pagination and advisory notices. Only small cosmetic text-fitting issues in the search field and linked-patient column.

issues.observation: The search placeholder wraps onto two lines inside a single-line-height input, making the field look cramped.
Linked patient IDs are truncated to "NCC-2026-0..." in every row, reducing their identifying value.

screens.summary: Create-reminder form layout is broken: the follow-up fields collapse into a narrow column, values wrap word-by-word outside their controls, labels collide, and most of the card is empty.

issues.observation: Reminder, Reminder date, Assigned to and Note are squeezed into a ~90-220px column while the right half of the card is blank; the reminder value renders as a vertical word stack and the note control is unusably small.
The labels Vaccine interest, Advance amount, Reminder and Assigned to run together on one line, and the Assigned-to value overflows its select, so the form cannot be read or used.

screens.summary: Finance overview is complete and well balanced: KPI cards, collections trend, payment-method mix and recent transactions are legible with consistent styling and fictional data.
Transactions list is clear and complete, with readable status badges, cash/online split, consistent table rhythm and working pagination. Truncated references are appropriately ellipsized.
Payment detail presents amount, split, status, visit metadata and linked service cleanly. Hierarchy and provisional-receipt treatment are clear with no clipping.
Record-payment form is well structured and legible, with correct cash/online split messaging, patient context and receipt state. No visible layout or data defects.
Expenses screen is complete and legible, with clear summary cards, filter controls, status badges and a well-aligned table. No blocking or cosmetic defects noted.
Record-expense form layout is broken: the field grid collapses into slivers, Title and Note values wrap vertically outside their controls, labels overlap, and the card is mostly blank.

issues.observation: Date, Category, Title and Reference are forced into a narrow column; the Title input is only a few characters wide and its value wraps one word per line beyond the field boundary.
Title and Reference labels overlap, the Note textarea is collapsed to a thin strip with vertically stacked text, and the left half of the form card is empty, making the form unusable.

screens.summary: Receipt preview is complete and convincing: receipt document, totals, payment split, print status and print settings all render cleanly with fictional data and no clipping.
Print-queue error state is purposeful and legible, with a clear failure banner, job facts, recovery actions, print options and history. No layout or data defects.
